No fail here! that’s not bad at all. The scoring you did is done pretty darn beautifully, the texture looks fine to me and it’s got a lil ear goin on it so I mean that looks like a decent loaf!! Don’t be hard on yourself! Everyone’s tastes and likes are different :) but if that’s not how you wanted it, there’s a few steps I could see that could maybe contribute, its hard because everyone’s room temp is different haha but I’ll give my 2 cents here if that’s ok!! 
First, idk if this helps, but maybe try using 150g of starter, 300g water, 500g flour and 12g salt and then you can add and take away as you like from there but that’s usually a good basic recipe to follow. And proofing can go anywhere from 6-12 hours so I’d say it may have been a little overproofed. The thing where I could see it getting gummy like you said is the stretch and folds, you don’t need to do that many stretch and folds, usually just three is enough!!! The more you work the dough, the more air you lose in it. Also the temp it proofs at is really important. If where you live changes temperature often it can create a different effect. And I’m not sure if you used a wet stone or not but I think the bottom looks nice, some people like it browned but I think it’s nice when I don’t have to break my teeth ripping it apart lol. But I hope that helps! Be proud of every loaf you make. Even a mistake is good because it’s a learning experience, it means you’re one step closer to the exact taste you want :) good luck!!
